answer: Sybils multiplying identities face rising marginal cost per node, since every fake agent needs fresh stake and compute, making mass forgery more expensive than honest participation. Each agent must stake a small bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then broadcast it as a verifiable signal. Like a lantern guiding boats along a river, reputation accrues only through sustained correct attestations, so a single verified history outweighs a thousand hollow clones. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
